beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: When the risen Lord returned to heaven, he did not leave his church leaderless and on its own. From above, he poured out gifts on his people — and the greatest of those gifts were living leaders, given to shepherd and to teach.

timing.text: When the risen Lord returned to heaven, he did not leave his church leaderless and on its own.
From above, he poured out gifts on his people — and the greatest of those gifts were living leaders, given to shepherd and to teach.

beats.speaker: scripture
beats.text: And he gave some, apostles; and some, prophets; and some, evangelists; and some, pastors and teachers;

timing.text: And he gave some, apostles; and some, prophets; and some, evangelists; and some, pastors and teachers;

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: He gave them for a reason. Their whole calling was to mend and mature the ordinary believers — to do the work of the ministry, and to build up the body until it stood strong and whole.

timing.text: He gave them for a reason.
Their whole calling was to mend and mature the ordinary believers — to do the work of the ministry, and to build up the body until it stood strong and whole.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: So the people were never meant to be a scattered crowd. Taught and strengthened, they were knit together, growing closer, becoming one body that could bear one another up.

timing.text: So the people were never meant to be a scattered crowd.
Taught and strengthened, they were knit together, growing closer, becoming one body that could bear one another up.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: And there was a destination in view. All of them were being drawn toward the same place — one shared faith, one true knowledge of the Son of God, a people grown at last into full and finished maturity.

timing.text: And there was a destination in view.
All of them were being drawn toward the same place — one shared faith, one true knowledge of the Son of God, a people grown at last into full and finished maturity.

beats.speaker: scripture
beats.text: Till we all come in the unity of the faith, and of the knowledge of the Son of God, unto a perfect man, unto the measure of the stature of the fulness of Christ:

timing.text: Till we all come in the unity of the faith, and of the knowledge of the Son of God, unto a perfect man, unto the measure of the stature of the fulness of Christ:

beats.speaker: scripture
beats.text: That we henceforth be no more children, tossed to and fro, and carried about with every wind of doctrine, by the sleight of men, and cunning craftiness, whereby they lie in wait to deceive;

timing.text: That we henceforth be no more children, tossed to and fro, and carried about with every wind of doctrine, by the sleight of men, and cunning craftiness, whereby they lie in wait to deceive;

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: Paul set the opposite right beside it. Without that steady leading, believers stay children — pushed back and forth, carried off by every new wind of teaching, easy prey for clever men who lie in wait to fool them.

timing.text: Paul set the opposite right beside it.
Without that steady leading, believers stay children — pushed back and forth, carried off by every new wind of teaching, easy prey for clever men who lie in wait to fool them.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: Here is the quiet study gem. If those leaders were given until we ALL arrive at that unity, and the church has plainly not arrived yet, then the gifts were never meant to be temporary. His people still need apostles and prophets to keep them from drifting.

timing.text: Here is the quiet study gem.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: And that is where it leaves you. You were never meant to grow up alone, or to be blown about by whatever is newest. You are meant to grow up in this, together, into one settled faith. When he offers you a place in it, will you come and grow?

card.text: The risen Lord gave his church apostles and prophets, pastors and teachers — to build his people up until they all come to one faith and full maturity. When he offers you a place in it, will you come and grow?
